unknown_grades.label: F1
unknown_grades.raw: **F1, assembly–rigidity challenge. `[protocol for C1]`** Use a preregistered family of gauge-inequivalent targets, one transcript-generation rule, one repertoire accounting convention, one local edit graph, and matched construction and evaluation budgets. Measure contextual assembly distance and local delivery rigidity before examining their association. The run refutes C1 on the declared domain when the preregistered association threshold is missed or a stable reversed order appears. Repertoire changes, censoring of failed constructions, and post-outcome edit-graph changes invalidate rather than rescue the run.
unknown_grades.title: F1, assembly–rigidity challenge

unknown_grades.label: F2
unknown_grades.raw: **F2, single-battery geometry–transmission challenge. `[protocol for C2]`** Split the declared reconstruction family into calibration and held-out members. Fix \(F^\circ\), its lossless transports, the local profile, the identifiability map \(\iota\), pinning order, transmission task, fidelity measure, and matched closed budgets before held-out outcomes are observed. First test C2-P1 and C2-P2 separately. Only a run passing both reaches C2. Failure of held-out pinning-order or transmission-order prediction at the preregistered threshold refutes C2 on that domain; it cannot be blamed on A5.
unknown_grades.title: F2, single-battery geometry–transmission challenge

Predeclare either delivered content at fixed cost or cost to a fixed delivered-content target as the primary measure. unknown_grades.label: F4
unknown_grades.raw: **F4, fixed-decoder reconstruction challenge. `[protocol for Conjecture R and E2]`** Freeze one answer-generic source-to-account decoder before exposing the scaling target family. Keep target identities, target-specific representations, later-use transports, specialist prompts, external appraisal, and hidden training examples outside the receiver boundary unless priced and declared. Test whether the receiver acquires the specified explanatory competence without receiver-owned construction and consequential appraisal. A verified fixed decoder that does so refutes Conjecture R on the declared class. A finite family cannot by itself establish or refute the unrestricted universal quantifier unless the class is exhaustively represented by a proved reduction.
unknown_grades.title: F4, fixed-decoder reconstruction challenge

unknown_grades.label: F5
unknown_grades.raw: **F5, bounded-prophet challenge. `[protocol for residue \(R_\Pi\)]`** Fix predictor description bound, positive lead time, observation channel, system class, and adversarial environment class. For a finite environment class, enumerate it exhaustively; for an open class, preregister the generator and scaling cuts. A bounded predictor that is uniformly correct on the entire declared class while every displayed condition holds refutes \(R_\Pi\) on that class. Failure caused by a shorter lead time, extra observation channel, fixed criteria, or non-adversarial environment does not reach the residue.
unknown_grades.title: F5, bounded-prophet challenge

unknown_grades.label: F6
unknown_grades.raw: **F6, residue stress test. `[protocol for the finite-prefix capstone]`** Before the base step, exhibit or fail \(\operatorname{CreativeCapacity}(\mathcal K_0)\) and \(R_{P,0}\) separately. At every successor cut, separately exhibit or fail \(R_{P,+}\), \(R_S\), and \(R_X^{\Phi}\) on the accumulated predecessor cut. No residue may be inferred from the others, from Conjecture O, or from the boxed capstone. A missing witness blocks the next prefix and records exactly which residue failed; the composition theorem remains intact but inapplicable.
unknown_grades.title: F6, residue stress test

unknown_grades.label: F7

Predeclare the admissible boundary and frame family, then audit W0–W5, package coherence, the identification map, A5 no-bypass, and, where claimed, WU and A1i. A failed witness kills that realization. A case satisfying the independently identified antecedent but admitting no realization over the complete preregistered boundary/frame family refutes the corresponding field instance of B-Core or B-Universal. Global refutation requires the stronger universal counterexample, not merely failure of one convenient cut.
